summary: Re-test of Jarvis Personal OS after iteration_2 fixes. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass against the public URL (root/health, chat + presets, chat empty-messages now correctly 400, chat/email/research validation 422, email draft, research summary + 6 live sources, build + refine). Frontend: all 5 tabs verified end to end. The HIGH-severity Copy-button crash is FIXED - clicking Copy with clipboard permission denied now shows 'Press Ctrl+C', produces no CRA runtime-error overlay and tab switching keeps working. App Builder error state (data-testid=build-error) verified via aborted /api/build, success path renders in a sandboxed iframe (sandbox='allow-scripts allow-popups allow-forms allow-modals') and Refine verifiably changed the app (heading -> ZEBRAQ) and cleared the refine input. Image tab: real Pollinations image rendered (naturalWidth 512) with W/H testids and download anchor; when the image request is aborted, data-testid=image-error appears, the spinner clears and the download link is hidden. Chat presets render as visible pills, footer present, mobile (390px) Email recipient/tone now stack to one column (352px wide each).

minor.issue: DuckDuckGo failure is swallowed (results=[]) and returned as HTTP 200 with a 'No live web results' summary - client cannot distinguish an outage from a genuinely empty result set. Cosmetic/by-design, low priority.

issues: iframe sandbox omits allow-same-origin, so any LLM-generated app that touches localStorage/sessionStorage throws inside the preview (observed: "Failed to read the 'localStorage' property from 'Window': The document is sandboxed and lacks the 'allow-same-origin' flag"). Persistence features in generated apps will silently break. Consider instructing the LLM to avoid web storage, or use a blob/srcdoc iframe with allow-same-origin only if the security trade-off is acceptable.

action_items: Optional: handle localStorage usage in generated preview apps (sandbox lacks allow-same-origin) - either prompt the LLM to avoid web storage or catch it.
Optional: distinguish DuckDuckGo outage from empty results in /api/research.
critical_code_review_comments: All iteration_2 review items are resolved: llm() now raises HTTPException(502), max_tokens is passed via with_params, /api/chat validates empty messages, iframe is sandboxed, BuildTab/ImageTab have real error states.
Legacy /app/app.py (Streamlit) still present in repo - remove to avoid confusion (per request it was ignored in testing).
App.js is ~390 lines but holds 5 feature tabs; splitting each tab into its own component file would improve maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None - app is stateless (no DB usage).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (12 tests, ~20s with xdist, all passing). test_chat_empty_messages now asserts 400. Public URL https://jarvis-os-52.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend flows verified: chat+presets, email draft+copy (clipboard-denied path safe), research summary+sources, image success+error (route-abort of image.pollinations.ai), build error path (route-abort of /api/build) + success + refine. No open blockers.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_2 HIGH bug root cause (unhandled navigator.clipboard rejection -> full-screen CRA overlay blocking the UI) is fixed by the try/catch + execCommand fallback + 'Press Ctrl+C' state in CopyBtn; verified no overlay and continued interactivity after a denied copy.
